left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients scheduled for elective knee arthroscopy

right.raw_text: -  Patients aged between 21 and 50 years old

left.raw_text: -  Patients with American Society of Anaesthesiologists physical status I or II

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients with known allergy to any drug used in the study

left.raw_text: -  Patients with chronic use of analgesics  [OR] and/or sedatives
-  Patients with renal  [OR] or hepatic dysfunction
